title: Open Generative Large Language Models for Galician

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language performance disparities by benchmarking models adapted to an under-resourced language (Galician) against multilingual baseline models on translated downstream tasks (e.g., reading comprehension, question answering) and through qualitative human evaluation.

bias_targets.target: Social bias (Racist, Sexist, and Hateful language)
bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative human evaluation where expert linguists annotated generated text continuations to identify instances of 'inappropriate content', specifically checking for racist, hateful, sexist, or insulting language.
